discovery_link.label: Selling a Business and Building: 1031 Planning | AE Tax

inbound_links.anchor: This guide is for established owners whose company occupies a building they own, directly or through another entity. Start the review while sale and lease terms are still negotiable. Ask for a combined after-tax cash forecast, supported by separate records for the business sale and retained property.
inbound_links.addition: If the buyer also wants the property, compare selling the business and building together, including a possible exchange of qualifying real estate, before choosing the retained-building route.

inbound_links.anchor: For a covered asset acquisition, the allocation connects the negotiated price with the assets reported by each party. Have the tax team review proposed equipment, inventory and intangible allocations before they become an unexplained exhibit in the final agreement.
inbound_links.addition: When the offer includes your company’s premises, use the combined business-and-building sale worksheet to identify the property seller, allocation and exchange funds before agreeing to closing terms.

For a sale that includes both operating assets and real estate, the business-and-building sale guide explains how the allocation connects to a potential Section 1031 exchange and separate closing funds.
